lines.en: On behalf of the Brown Birds of America, I salute you.
Just admit it, Charlie. You have no backhand.
Excuse me, little one. I have a very solid backhand.
Shielding your face and shrieking like a girl
I was shrieking... like a marine.
All right, here. Watch me execute the three Ps of championship play.
You broke a little girl's leg.
I know. I feel horrible, okay?
It says here that a Muppet got whacked on Sesame Street last night.
Where exactly were you around tennis?
